name: 14621 · Rochester, NY
findings: ZIP 14621 (Rochester) has 85 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (58% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14621 (Rochester) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 14621 (Rochester) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 68% of the typical level).
